hero.intro: Automatic confirmation, 24h reminder and cancellation messages for your patients.

setupPending.title: ⚠ WhatsApp integration not yet configured on the server.
setupPending.body: The platform administrator must configure the Z-API credentials and pair the sending number. You can edit templates and enable below — it will start working as soon as setup is complete.

statusCard.footnote: Shared platform sending number. The patient receives automated messages but does not reply directly to that number — you set your own contact phone below.

general.hint: When disabled, no message is sent (even with templates configured).
general.clinicNameHint: Appears in the message signature (variable {{nome_clinica}}).
general.phoneClinicHint: Appears in the message so the patient can call if they have questions ({{telefone_clinica}}).

templates.intro: Customize the text for each message type. Leave blank to use the default template.
templates.placeholder: Leave blank to use the default template.
templates.confirmHint: Sent immediately when a session is created with the patient's WhatsApp filled in.
templates.reminderHint: Triggered automatically 24h before the scheduled time.
templates.cancelHint: Sent when the session is cancelled by the professional.

test.intro: Send a test message to your own WhatsApp number to confirm the integration is working before creating real sessions.

js.statusPendingDetail: The platform administrator has not yet configured the Z-API credentials. Your messages will only start being sent after this step.
js.statusConnectedDetail: Platform number paired and ready to send messages.
js.statusDisconnectedDetail: The Z-API instance is configured, but the sending number isn't paired right now (probably WhatsApp Web was signed out). Let support know if this persists.
js.confirmReset: Clear the 3 custom templates? You'll go back to the platform default texts.
js.testZapiNotConfig: Z-API credentials not yet configured by the platform administrator.
